| 12 | 重排反应结束后，蒸馏脱溶后取产品5g溶解在30%含水甲醇中，升温至60℃，加入1g活性炭保温一小时后热过滤，控温滴加10%稀盐酸调节PH为2,逐渐降温至15℃，过滤得纯化环磺酮。 | 1257 | 37 | 95% |

| 11 | After the rearrangement reaction had finished, the solvent was removed by distillation, then 5 g of the product was taken and dissolved in 20% aqueous methanol, the temperature was raised to 60 C, 1 g of activated carbon was added and the temperature held for one hour, then hot filtration; after the methanol had been removed, 10 g of fresh water was added, 10% dilute hydrochloric acid was added dropwise under temperature control to adjust the PH to 2, the temperature was gradually lowered to 15 C, and filtration gave purified tembotrione. | 1257 | 31 | 96% |
| 12 | After the rearrangement reaction had finished, the solvent was removed by distillation, then 5 g of the product was taken and dissolved in 30% aqueous methanol, the temperature was raised to 60 C, 1 g of activated carbon was added and the temperature held for one hour, then hot filtration; 10% dilute hydrochloric acid was added dropwise under temperature control to adjust the PH to 2, the temperature was gradually lowered to 15 C, and filtration gave purified tembotrione. | 1257 | 37 | 95% |
|  | After the rearrangement reaction had finished, the solvent was removed by distillation, then 5 g of the product was taken and dissolved in 40% aqueous |  |  |  |
paragraphs.notes: This paragraph marker has no text of its own in the text layer. Its printed content is a table image that carries no text layer at all, so every value above was read from the pixels of runs/CN111440099B/input/pages/p08.png, zoomed, and each number was read twice. The table is the one announced as Table Three at [0043] on the previous page; no caption and no footnote is printed on this page, the table body simply begins at the top of the page body with its column header row reprinted. It continues from the previous page: the batch numbers on this page start at 11, so batches numbered below 11 are not on this page, and only what is printed on this page is transcribed here. The condition being varied sits inside the treatment-method column as the water content of the aqueous methanol (20% for batch 11, 30% for batch 12, 40% for batch 13); the third and fourth columns are the cyanide impurity content before and after treatment in ppm, and the fifth is the printed reduction percentage. The last row of this image block is cut in the middle of its treatment-method cell: only the batch-number cell (blank), the first two printed lines of the method cell and three blank numeric cells appear here, and that row is completed in the [0045] block as batch 13. Empty markdown cells above are cells printed blank in that cut row, not unreadable cells. Batch 11 alone carries the step of removing the methanol and adding 10 g of fresh water; batches 12 and 13 go straight from hot filtration to the acid addition. Two punctuation readings taken off the pixels: in batch 11 the comma after the hot-filtration phrase is printed half-width and the comma after the pH value 2 is full-width, while in batch 12 it is the other way round, and both are recorded as printed rather than normalised. The line-internal spaces that the justification of these narrow cells puts between Chinese characters and Latin or numeric runs are print artifacts and are not reproduced; the cell text is given as one continuous run. The printed reduction percentages do not agree with the two content columns they sit beside; that is recorded in discrepancies. Nothing was recomputed, rounded or adjusted; every cell above is as printed.

paragraphs.zh: 将产品环磺酮在不同吸附剂中处理后的氰化物杂质含量对比如下表四：
paragraphs.en: A comparison of the cyanide impurity content of the product tembotrione after treatment in different adsorbents is given in Table Four below:
paragraphs.notes: Taken verbatim from the text layer. This sentence announces Table Four, but no part of Table Four is printed on this page: below this line the page is blank down to the footer, so the table it announces must begin on the following page. The product named in this sentence is tembotrione. Note that Table Four varies the adsorbent, whereas the table transcribed at [0044] and [0045] above varies the water content, so the two are different experiments.

discrepancies.what: The printed reduction column of this table disagrees with the two cyanide-content columns printed beside it, in all three batches on this page. The disagreement is arithmetic and internal to the table image; it is not a disagreement with any prose on this page. Confirmed by the coordinator to run through all five tables in this patent, not only this one. Every printed cell is left exactly as printed.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Printed cells, batch 11: original 1257 ppm, after treatment 31 ppm, reduction 96%. Batch 12: 1257 ppm, 37 ppm, 95%. Batch 13: 1257 ppm, 12 ppm, 98%.
discrepancies.text_says: Computed from the two printed content columns, not printed anywhere on the page: batch 11 is a 97.53% reduction against the printed 96%, batch 12 is 97.06% against the printed 95%, and batch 13 is 99.05% against the printed 98%. These three percentages are computed values, supplied here only to state the size of the disagreement, and no printed cell was changed to match them. No prose on this page states a reduction percentage.

discrepancies.what: Reading disagreement on the first character of the first column header, recorded rather than resolved. The coordinator reads that character, from the copy of this header printed on p05, as the one meaning actual or experiment, giving 'experiment batch'. On p08 it is the character meaning test or trial: checked twice at 7x zoom, the glyph carries the three-stroke speech radical on the left and the phonetic for 'style' on the right, with no roof radical above, so on this page the header reads 'test batch'. The zh cell is left as printed on this page. Whether p05 genuinely prints a different character or the two readings simply differ is not decidable from p08 alone, and is left open.
discrepancies.drawing_says: p08 header row, first column: the character for test or trial plus batch, that is 'test batch'.
discrepancies.text_says: Coordinator reading of the same header printed on p05: the character for actual or experiment plus batch, that is 'experiment batch'.
